doc.name: Last Price
doc.description: Pricing compute for agents: quote a price, verify a price someone proposed, and record whether it was accepted. One API, any pricing logic, metered per call.

extensions.description: Each skill is a plain HTTP JSON operation on url. There is no A2A message/send endpoint yet; call the operation listed for the skill.

operations.auth: x-api-key or OAuth bearer, or an x402 payment with no credential where pay per call is offered

extensions.description: compute-price can be bought one call at a time with an x402 payment and no account.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: API key. Get one with no human at POST /api/agents/register.

skills.name: Compute a price
skills.description: Quote a price for a product or a call from its context (product type, current price, currency, costs, competitor offer) and optional constraints. Returns the price, confidence, the function that computed it and a receipt.

skills.name: Verify a price
skills.description: Check a price someone proposed against its context. Returns a verdict (fair, too_high, too_low or unknown), the band it was judged against, the deviation and the evidence, so a buyer can decide whether to accept, counter or walk away.

skills.name: Record an outcome
skills.description: Report whether a computed price was accepted or rejected, against the receipt it came with. On a workspace with outcome pricing, a rejection inside the window pays part of the price back.
